task_summary: Scrape two Paul Graham essays from paulgraham.com and convert them to a single audiobook MP3 using TTS APIs (OpenAI/ElevenLabs) with local fallback
decomposition_rationale: The task has two distinct functional domains: (1) web scraping and text extraction/cleaning, and (2) TTS synthesis with API fallback and audio concatenation. Separating these concerns allows each skill to be independently reusable and testable, while keeping the decomposition minimal.

skills.name: evo-web-essay-scraper
skills.description: Scrapes and extracts clean text from Paul Graham's essays on paulgraham.com. Handles the site's legacy table-based HTML, character encoding issues, and navigational boilerplate removal. Also provides text chunking utilities for downstream TTS consumption.
skills.responsibility: Fetching essay HTML, parsing DOM to extract essay body text, cleaning text artifacts, and chunking text into API-safe segments (respecting character limits)

skills.name: evo-tts-audiobook-synth
skills.description: Converts text chunks into speech audio using a cascading fallback strategy: tries OpenAI TTS first, then ElevenLabs, then local TTS (edge-tts/gTTS). Handles API authentication, rate limiting, binary audio capture, and concatenation of chunk audio segments into a single MP3 file.
skills.responsibility: TTS API integration (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, edge-tts, gTTS), retry/backoff logic, MP3 chunk generation, and audio concatenation into final output file
dr_sections: 6. Fallback to Local TTS (Ubuntu 24.04, No GPU)
